Looking for a production job in Harmelen? Work as a Production Worker printing logos on T-shirts and workwear for €14.99 per hour. Full-time, clean workplace, regular hours.

You work in a small, friendly team of about 15 people, in a clean production hall with a normal temperature - no cold! The workday is 7.5 hours with regular breaks, and you'll always have support from colleagues. This is a great job if you like working with your hands, want a stable schedule, and appreciate a tidy workplace. Basic English language skills (A2) are enough, so you can easily understand instructions and communicate at work. If you value precision and want a steady job with nice people, this is for you!
